scopeNote: integration contract: Pure-Dart Flutter client conforming to firebase_app_check_platform_interface via the Pyric WebSocket bridge. Covers PyricFirebaseAppCheckPlatform registration and per-app delegates, multi-platform activate() provider resolution and sandbox RS256 JWT minting, useAppCheckEmulator(host, port), getToken/getTokenResult/getLimitedUseToken caching and coalescing, onTokenChange streams, setTokenAutoRefreshEnabled, opWithAppCheck cross-service propagation, and FirebaseException error normalization.
